Order from Shustryi an autonomous UAV recon drone with a control station. After purchase a control station appears in the shelter near the medic/trader corner — walk up to the laptop and refuel the drone with one button press. 
 
 While the UAV is charged: 
 - All known stashes with contents are highlighted on the PDA map. 
 - Anomaly-field circles turn cyan when an artifact is inside them (artifact detector). 
 - If an NPC picks up an artifact, the UAV sends a PDA alert (faction, armor, direction). 
 
 Refuel: 1 fuel canister (if in inventory) or 45 000 RU. Fuel has priority. Charge burns on return to shelter.
